title: Canonical finite Tate source map
statement: For a purity finite setting and a strict Frobenius map on a finite-coefficient derived object, define the canonical source isomorphism using the geometric-Frobenius pullback square with source over-structure g_X ≫ a_X and target structure a_X, exactly as in [def-pur-tate-datum]. Also define the same twisted construction for a Cartesian Frobenius square and the pasted pullback comparison.
